d: The scene: the proof room of a theater. Corilla, Procolo, Luigia, Dorotea, Don Prospero, Guglielmo, the Impresario, Biscroma and various Choirs, all sitting around a piano, in the process of concerting the opera.
Come back to the Enterprise, with Prospero and Procolo.
Get in Agata with the sheets in her hand.
Guglielmo and Biscroma are coming in. Agate goes to meet them.
Biscroma Ripper and Agata. Then the Impresario, Procolo, Luigia and Prospero.
Biscroma, Agata, Procolo, Luigia and Prospero. Then Corilla.
The Inspector appears on the door.
A stage at the time of the test: the Impresario and Mamm'Agata are present.
As Agata comes out shouting "Burlon," "Burlon" enters Prospero.
Agata and Luigia are coming in.
Bismroma comes in, followed by Procolo, then Corilla.
The previous Actors minus Procolo and Corilla.
Biscroma, the Impresario, Prospero and Corilla, then Procolo.
As the orchestra plays the gloomy march it is conducted before Procolo as a trophy of victory Agata dressed as a slave to be sacrificed by himself to the gods. Luigia also enters.
